title: The NS obstruction as a local-cohomology residue
html:
Remark. The NS obstruction as a local-cohomology residue

We measure the NS obstruction consistently across every level of the brane tower by restricting \kappa_n onto the collision locus \Sigma. It remains nonzero (confirming NS-singular blowup) if and only if the local cohomology H^1_{\mathfrak{m}_p}(A) holds a nonzero value at collision points. This matches the exact condition where the Levi form evades degeneracy (maintaining a bounded core aspect ratio). The Levi degeneracy conjecture isolates whether \kappa_n|_\Sigma collapses or survives through the strict q \to 1 limit.
